refnamediv.refpurpose: Changes the watched events and the associated data

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
events
A non-empty list of Io\Poll\Event cases. It combines the conditions to watch for, such as Io\Poll\Event::Read and Io\Poll\Event::Write, with the Io\Poll\Event::OneShot and Io\Poll\Event::EdgeTriggered modifiers.
data
The new value to associate with the watcher. If the argument is omitted, the current data is kept; passing &null; explicitly replaces it with &null;.

&reftitle.errors;
Throws a TypeError if events is empty or contains a value that is not an Io\Poll\Event case.
Throws an Io\Poll\InactiveWatcherException if the watcher is no longer active.
Throws an Io\Poll\FailedWatcherModificationException if the backend rejects the new events, for example when Io\Poll\Event::EdgeTriggered is requested from a backend that does not support it.
